text: 11月6日，香港证券及期货事务监察委员会发表咨询总结，就进一步限制不受规管的机构使用具误导性的名称以保障投资者，相关修订建议获市场广泛支持。香港证监会表示，将扩大受限制称衔清单，并建立更快更新清单的机制，同时把监管覆盖延伸至虚拟资产领域，从源头减少投资者因机构名称产生误判，夯实投资者保护防线。
text_en: On November 6, the Securities and Futures Commission (SFC) of Hong Kong published a consultation conclusions paper on further restricting the use of misleading names by unregulated entities to protect investors, with the proposed amendments receiving broad market support. The SFC said it will expand the list of restricted titles and establish a mechanism for updating the list more quickly, while extending regulatory coverage to the virtual asset sector, reducing investors' misjudgments caused by institution names at the source and shoring up investor protection.
